[EN] To Soothe a Crying Child
[ES] Para calmar a un niño llorón
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] "I'll see what's going on."
[ES] "Veré qué está pasando."
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Speak to Anya.
[ES] Habla con Anya.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] "Thank you for being honest, Niyum."
[ES] "Gracias por ser honesto, Niyum."
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Ask Niyum about Anya's doll.
[ES] Pregúntale a Niyum por la muñeca de Anya.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Search the bushes for Anya's doll.
[ES] Busca la muñeca de Anya entre los arbustos.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] "Maybe I can repair the doll...?"
[ES] "¿Tal vez pueda reparar la muñeca...?"
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Pick up Anya's doll from the grass near the bushes.
[ES] Recoge la muñeca de Anya de la hierba cerca de los arbustos.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] "It's worth a try."
[ES] "Vale la pena intentarlo."
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Ask Jerdan why he took Zo-Zo.
[ES] Pregúntale a Jerdan por qué se llevó a Zo-Zo.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Gather sticky grass.
[ES] Recolecta hierba pegajosa.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Use the needle and sticky grass to repair Anya's doll.

[Press key to open the Inventory window, then right-click the needle.]
[ES] Usa la aguja y la hierba pegajosa para reparar la muñeca de Anya.

[Presiona la tecla para abrir la ventana del Inventario y luego haz clic derecho en la aguja.]
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] "Okay, Anya."
[ES] "De acuerdo, Anya."
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Take Zo-Zo back to Anya.
[ES] Lleva a Zo-Zo de vuelta con Anya.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Play with Anya and Zo-Zo.
[ES] Juega con Anya y Zo-Zo.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] "Okay."
[ES] "Está bien."
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Talk to Anya.
[ES] Habla con Anya.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026
